name: Kuala Lumpur
subject: the Sultan Abdul Samad Building clock tower and its domes facing Merdeka Square
composition: the clock tower tall on the left, the domed arcade stretching to the right, the square in front
placement: curved around the circle between two concentric border lines, like a classic round passport stamp (top arc, and the bottom arc if there is a second line)

name: Penang
subject: a Penang trishaw and the clan jetty wooden stilt houses over the sea
composition: the trishaw large in the foreground on the left, the stilt houses small behind on the right
placement: in a solid straight header bar across the top, the letters reversed out (paper colour) inside the inked bar

name: Langkawi
subject: the Langkawi Sky Bridge curving over jungle-covered peaks, with a sea eagle
composition: the curved bridge sweeping across the middle, peaks below, the eagle above
placement: curved along the inside of the arch top, following its curve

name: Melaka
subject: the red Christ Church and Stadthuys of Melaka with a decorated trishaw
composition: the church front-on in the middle, the trishaw parked in the lower right
placement: in one ribbon banner across the top edge; no other ribbons or banners

name: Sabah
subject: Mount Kinabalu's jagged granite peaks above rainforest, with an orangutan on a branch
composition: the orangutan close up on a branch in the foreground, the mountain behind
placement: as very large bold block letters across the middle like a vintage 'greetings from' postcard, the scene visible behind and inside the letters (any second line small underneath)

name: Sarawak
subject: a rhinoceros hornbill and a traditional longhouse on stilts by a river
composition: a close-up of the hornbill's head and casque in the upper half, the longhouse small below
placement: set vertically down the left edge, one upright letter under another, inside a narrow vertical strip of the border

name: Ipoh
subject: the colonial Ipoh railway station with limestone hills behind
composition: a wide view of the long station facade, the limestone hills rising behind
placement: on a large luggage tag — about a quarter of the stamp's width — hanging from the lower right corner of the border by a loop of string, the lettering big and easy to read on the tag

name: Johor Bahru
subject: the Sultan Abu Bakar State Mosque on its hill above the Straits of Johor, with the Causeway
composition: the mosque on the hill on the right, the water and the long Causeway across the bottom
placement: curved along the inside of the dome's round top; the flat bottom edge has no lettering

name: Malaysia
subject: the Petronas Twin Towers with the KL Tower and city skyline behind, clouds, hibiscus flowers and palm fronds
composition: layered depth: hibiscus and palm fronds in the foreground corners, the twin towers in the middle, skyline and clouds behind
placement: curved along the inside of the arch top, following its curve

name: Malaysia
subject: a traditional Malay kampung house on stilts with coconut palms and a wau kite flying above
shape: square with a perforated postage-stamp edge
composition: the house on the right, palms on the left, the kite high in the sky
placement: in a solid straight header bar across the bottom, the letters reversed out (paper colour) inside the inked bar

name: Singapore
subject: the Merlion fountain with Marina Bay Sands and the Supertrees behind
composition: the Merlion on the left spouting water, the skyline across the back
placement: curved along the top arc of the circle between two concentric border lines, like a classic round passport stamp; the bottom of the border has no lettering

name: Singapore
subject: the Supertrees of Gardens by the Bay with the Singapore Flyer wheel
composition: looking up at the Supertrees from below, the Flyer behind on the right
placement: in a solid straight header bar across the top, the letters reversed out (paper colour) inside the inked bar
